items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Risk severity is high for fleet-wide go-live, new public exposure, and security-sensitive releases; ordinary reversible growth may continue conditionally. Evidence: security baseline covers 61 managed sites, but fleet-doctor has no run, checks, findings, or site results; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error-sweep results; and authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown. Exact decision: do not clear launch or security-sensitive release gates; continue only bounded reversible changes that add no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, cross-site behavior, or unsupported claims.

items.title: Maintain fleet security evidence-needed disposition and release gates
items.summary: Maintain an evidence-needed security disposition because fleet-doctor and operations results are absent and material controls remain unverified. Preserve private-launch and security-sensitive release gates while allowing constrained reversible growth within existing data, consent, disclosure, and claims boundaries.
items.requested_action: Continue the existing authorized read-only control-evidence matrix using retained artifacts and metadata only. Record dated evidence or explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, deploy, add dependencies, conduct external outreach, or request duplicate telemetry.
